newsitem.title: USA: Group holds 14.5 pct Heftel "A" stake.
newsitem.headline: Group holds 14.5 pct Heftel "A" stake.

text.p: A group led by New York investor Ronald Baron said Tuesday it has bought 987,000 class A common shares of Heftel Broadcasting Corp, representing 14.5 percent of the class outstanding.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it paid $29.04 million for the stake and holds it for investment.
Baron is president of Baron Capital Management Inc, a New York-based investment firm.
Heftel, based in Las Vegas, is the largest Spanish-language radio broadcaster in the U.S.
